ECONOMIC_PRESERVATION.does_accuracy_improvement_come_at_cost_o: NO - MFE, MAE, eventual excursion, P(MFE>=k ATR) and 1:1 tradeability are all within ~1-5% of the 300s benchmark at matched frozen first-crossing thresholds, both directions, p90 and p95
ECONOMIC_PRESERVATION.evidence: At the p90 first-crossing population the 180s signal fires ~55s closer to the flip (median 130s vs 185s to flip) yet the subsequent path is essentially unchanged: MFE at 300s post-signal ~0.91-0.93 ATR (180s) vs ~0.94-0.95 (300s); eventual max MFE ~1.30 ATR vs ~1.35; MAE identical; 1:1 favorable-before-adverse within 300s ~0.43 for BOTH horizons; P(MFE>=1 ATR) ~0.60 vs ~0.62. The tighter horizon removes weak predictions faster than it removes reversal opportunity.

INTERPRETATION.better_flip_classifier: YES - ROC-AUC rises +0.028/+0.028 (LONG/SHORT) and base-rate-relative PR-AUC lift rises (1.95x vs 1.59x at the full surface; ~3.0x vs ~2.4x precision lift at the p97.5 crossing). Raw PR-AUC and Brier fall, but only because the 180s base rate is ~half the 300s base rate.
INTERPRETATION.better_timing_signal: YES - at matched frozen thresholds the 180s first-crossing fires ~50-55s closer to the flip (median 130s vs 185s at p90; 105s vs 155s at p95).
INTERPRETATION.economic_move_preserved: YES - MFE, MAE, eventual excursion, P(MFE>=k ATR) and 1:1 tradeability are all within a few percent of the 300s benchmark. The shorter horizon does not trivialize the prediction.
INTERPRETATION.direction_specific_findings: LONG and SHORT behave near-identically on every axis; no directional divergence.
INTERPRETATION.one_to_one_tradeability_readout: ~43% of high-confidence first-crossings reach +1 ATR favorable before -1 ATR adverse within 300s (50% over a full 600s race) - real but roughly coin-flip, at BOTH horizons. This is descriptive evidence for the next research question (a model predicting flip + favorable MFE/MAE geometry), not a tradeable edge on its own.
INTERPRETATION.recommended_next_step: Open 2024 OOS on the frozen 180s winner vs the frozen 300s parent to confirm the TRAIN picture holds out of sample, then scope the flip + MFE/MAE-geometry model on the 180s horizon.
